_doc: MISUMI's pre-assembly insertion square nut (HNKK5) for its 5 series, 6 mm slot, M3. Sheet metal, cheaper than the block nuts. Hold: MISUMI gives no figure.
name: slot-nut-6-misumi-m3-square

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 5 series (slot width 6 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M3, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

nut_kind.rule: A plain plate, slid in from the end of the slot upside down (the catalogue's words)
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot: 15 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot: 10 on the drawing
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

height.rule: Its thickness: 3 on the drawing (a pressed plate with a raised collar round its thread)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Pre-assembly insertion: slid in from an open end of the slot before the frame is closed
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-561, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_561.pdf

hold.rule: Half Rexroth's 6 mm sliding block (3000 N): a thin plate bends under the lips before a block does. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m3 thread set (ISO 898-1)
